form:FormGroup.label: Converter Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: How the text converter content is interpreted. Data Splitter: XML in the data-splitter namespace that splits text into records. XML Fragment: a wrapper that turns XML fragments into a complete document. None: no type is set. Parsers treat it as Data Splitter, except the XML Fragment Parser, which rejects it.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Data Splitter, XML Fragment or None.
